notes.title: Demo version
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone, today the demo version is available. I will be interested in your feedback, this is something new, I haven't made horrors and puzzles for a long time, I want another game like this in my portfolio
[/b]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824650/PLACE_Demo"][/dynamiclink]
You are a random person trapped in an empty \[b]concrete room\[/b] under the watchful eye of a camera. The only way out is to risk pressing the forbidden button, after which more \[b]buttons\[/b] appear. Each press brings you closer to the exit or to your demise.

If you like this idea, add it to your wishlist and follow the development in my discord channel[/p]
